name: Koch Fertilizer
description: Nitrogen fertilizer producer and distributor with five production facilities in the United States and one in Canada, more than 50 terminals, and more than 12 million metric tons of product distributed annually; products include ammonia, urea, UAN, phosphate, ammonium thiosulfate and diesel exhaust fluid.
